messages:
Alex: quick share — ran an ISO-QPS sprint comparing A100 vs H100 across a small mix of commonly served 7B models (Llama-2-7b, Mistral-7b, Falcon-7b). split prefill vs decode, tokens/sec, and $/1M tokens. attaching numbers inline.

Rachel: awesome, was QPS same across runs?

Alex: yes — iso QPS: 100 qps sustained, 8s context (avg 204 tokens request), warm cache for prefill tests. two regions: us-west1 and eu-west1.

Sam: can you paste the command/flags you used so I can reproduce?

Alex: sure — spawned identical containers w/ same batcher config and kernel flags. command:```bash
./bench_runner --model ${MODEL} --seq 204 --tokens 204 --qps 100 --duration 600 
  --kernel_policy auto --quant none --warm_cache true 
```

Morgan: did you try quantized variants or just fp16?

Alex: primarily fp16 runtime for fair kernel comparison. did one pass with int8 (GPTQ-ish) on Mistral-7b to sanity-check quality impact.

Rachel: raw numbers?

Alex: pasted concise table below (per-GPU, avg across 5 runs):
- Llama-2-7b: A100 prefill 28ms/token, decode 6.5ms/token, tokens/sec 1500, $/1M tokens $8.2
- Llama-2-7b: H100 prefill 22ms/token, decode 5.2ms/token, tokens/sec 1750, $/1M tokens $7.1
- Mistral-7b: A100 prefill 30ms/token, decode 6.8ms/token, tokens/sec 1420, $/1M tokens $8.7
- Mistral-7b: H100 prefill 23ms/token, decode 5.6ms/token, tokens/sec 1680, $/1M tokens $7.3
- Falcon-7b: A100 prefill 32ms/token, decode 7.1ms/token, tokens/sec 1380, $/1M tokens $9.0
- Falcon-7b: H100 prefill 24ms/token, decode 5.9ms/token, tokens/sec 1600, $/1M tokens $7.6

Sam: interesting — H100 wins across the board but $ delta depends on cloud sku pricing. did you normalize for instance hourly cost?

Alex: yes numbers use our internal per-GPU hour costs (including egress & infra overhead) to compute $/1M tokens: cost = (hourly_rate / tokens_per_hour) * 1e6. tokens_per_hour derived from tokens/sec * 3600.

Jia: what about kernel fallthroughs? any kernels triggered that changed perf between runs?

Alex: we saw occasional kernel fallbacks on A100 for Falcon (attention kernel selecting a fallback path for long prefills). H100 used optimized fused attention path in most runs. added a trace sample:```text
[DEBUG] kernel_select: model=Falcon-7b, seq=204 => selected_kernel=attn_fused_v2 on H100
[DEBUG] kernel_select: model=Falcon-7b, seq=204 => selected_kernel=attn_generic on A100 (fallback x3)
```

Morgan: did batcher shape differ? continuous batching identical — we pinned max_batch 16, async flush 30ms.

Rachel: what about regional variance? us-west vs eu-west?

Alex: latency delta small ~2-4% worse in eu-west due to instance SKU mix (older A100 host machines there). tokens/sec stable. cost slightly higher in eu due to regional price multipliers.

Sam: how did int8/quant affect quality & perf on Mistral?

Alex: int8 gave ~25% tokens/sec improvement on H100 (from 1680 -> 2100) and ~18% on A100, but eval with our 800-prompt evalset showed minor quality drift (bleu/rouge style metrics down ~1.8 points). flagged as a potential regression — need targeted eval prompts.

Jia: any kernel tuning suggestions for ops team?

Alex: for A100: force-enable tiled-attn and prefer cuBLAS matmul algorithm X when seq>128; for H100: let auto pick fused attention but enable fp16 math relax. added flags used:```yaml
kernel_policy: auto
prefer_kernels: [tiled_attn, fused_attn]
matmul_algo_hint: X
quant: none
```

bench-bot: automated-summary uploaded: s3://redwood-bench/2201234567/summary.csv :thumbsup:

Morgan: action items?

Rachel: (1) Ops: try forced tiled-attn patch on A100 host image and rerun Falcon samples in eu-west. (2) ML: run targeted eval for int8 Mistral prompts and check hallucination/regression slices. (3) Product: sanity check price delta messaging for customers choosing H100 vs A100.

Sam: I'll pick up (1) — creating a small AMI with tiled-attn and scheduling 3 runs next week.

Jia: I'll own (2) — will run eval harness and report PR curves.

Alex: thanks — saving raw traces and perf traces under the s3 path above.

Rachel: thanks team. :rocket:
